How to add image descriptions in posts from >x<.com

runs: When you post photos using the >x< app for iOS or Android, or on >x<.com, you have the option to compose a description of the images so the content is accessible to more people, including those who are blind or low-vision.
Good image descriptions are concise and descriptive, helping people understand what’s happening in an image.

title: How to add image descriptions in posts from >x<.com

runs: Open the
using the keyboard shortcut (press the “n” key).
Use the “tab” key to navigate to the
button and press “enter”.
Use the file system dialog to choose the image to add.
In the composer, find the image you've added using the “tab” key. The image will be labeled according to the order in which it was added (e.g. "Image 1").
To insert descriptive text, open the thumbnail preview dialog by pressing the “enter” key while focused on the image.
Type your description of the image. (The limit is 1000 characters.)
Find the
button by pressing the “tab” key and press “enter”, or just press “enter” while holding down the “command” key.
To edit the description, re-open the thumbnail preview dialog prior to posting the post.
